title: Bayesian Filtering in Physical Systems via Test-time Trained Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2609.23383v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bayesian filtering provides a principled framework for online state estimation under uncertainty, yet its application to systems with high-dimensional states and complicated posterior distributions remains challenging. Recent generative models, such as flow matching, have shown potential in Bayesian filtering. However, they still rely on particle-based representations of the posterior, which lose the rich information of the full distribution, or tackle a trajectory-level inverse problem that conflicts with the recursive structure of Bayesian filtering. To address this, we propose a new perspective of directly encoding the evolving distribution into flow matching model weights, namely, the Belief Flow Filter (BFF). It is a generative filtering framework that updates model weights via gradient descent at test time to track the posterior evolution. Thereby, BFF bypasses the scalability issue of particle representations or the flexibility

translated_title: 通过测试时训练的流匹配实现物理系统中的贝叶斯滤波
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯滤波为不确定性条件下的在线状态估计提供了一个有原则的框架，但其在具有高维状态和复杂后验分布的系统中的应用仍然充满挑战。近期的生成模型（如流匹配）已在贝叶斯滤波中展现出潜力。然而，这些方法仍然依赖于基于粒子的后验表示，从而丢失了完整分布所包含的丰富信息，或者处理与贝叶斯滤波递归结构相冲突的轨迹级逆问题。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个新视角：将不断演化的分布直接编码到流匹配模型的权重中，即信念流滤波器。这是一个生成式滤波框架，在测试时通过梯度下降更新模型权重以跟踪后验分布的演化。由此，BFF 绕过了粒子表示的可扩展性问题或灵活性限制。
tldr: 提出信念流滤波器（BFF），通过在测试时用梯度下降更新流匹配模型权重来直接编码后验分布的演化，从而绕过粒子表示的可扩展性限制，实现高维复杂物理系统中的贝叶斯滤波。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Belief Flow Filter (BFF), which directly encodes the evolving posterior distribution into flow matching model weights updated via test-time gradient descent, bypassing the scalability limitations of particle-based representations for Bayesian filtering in high-dimensional physical systems.
